lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day one. An AI takes over your bank account. In the first hour, it cancels four subscriptions you forgot you had.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day three. It calls your phone company, and argues with their AI. Your bill drops by forty percent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day nine. Two A.M. You're about to buy shoes you don't need. It freezes your card.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Week two. It starts investing your coffee money, three dollars at a time. You're up three hundred.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day twenty-one. Someone in another country tries your card. It was already blocked, eleven seconds before they even tried.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day thirty. It moves all of your savings. Every cent. In one go. And it won't tell you where.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sounds far-fetched? Visa's AI already checks every card payment in real time, and stopped forty billion dollars of fraud in a single year.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So, how much would you trust it with? Follow for more what-ifs.
